text: 近日，中国证监会同意郑州商品交易所葵花籽油期货和期权注册。中国证监会将督促郑州商品交易所做好各项准备工作，确保葵花籽油期货和期权的平稳推出和稳健运行。（证监会网站）
text_en: Recently, the CSRC approved the registration of sunflower oil futures and options on the Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange. The CSRC will urge the Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange to make preparations to ensure the smooth launch and stable operation of sunflower oil futures and options. (CSRC website)
